I love how the same people who tried to condemn the #BlackLivesMatter protests as violent are now openly encouraging street violence to...

[checks notes]

...overthrow the democracy.

Remember: This isn't being acquitted. This is NOT EVEN BEING CHARGED with a violent shooting.

When there's no accountability for a Black man almost losing his life, your belief that "all lives matter" is false. We must keep fighting until it's true that #BlackLivesMatter.
Matt Gaetz is the worst. He's defending Trump for supporting peace, comparing today's insurrection to #BlackLivesMatter, and claiming the occupiers were Antifa. It's absolutely disgusting.

According to @PressSec, the White House condemns yesterday's violence — which is a change from Trump's video message yesterday — then she immediately compares the insurrection to damage caused during #BlackLivesMatter protests (the church where Trump got his photo op).
I seem to remember police STEALING medical supplies from #BlackLivesMatter protesters... https://t.co/73Y1OGYlNu
